description: Exact rational centres, one per occupied cell, inside each state's own closed cells of the H-266 cover and pairwise at squared distance at least 1, for the endpoint's state (a control) and the 95 distance-2 orbit representatives of the exp-308 descriptor, the frozen first eight among them. Each vector is accepted by build_model and check_primal of packing/devtools/n17_shared_centre_lp.py.
evidential_status: Relaxation survival only: an exact feasible primal of the shared-centre relaxation and of the incircle constraints. Not a packing, not an exclusion, not an admission, and not a registered W6 experiment.

produced_by.method: Float proposal (softmax-barycentric centres in each cell, L-BFGS-B on the squared shortfall below distance 1.002), then exact rational barycentric weights, rounding to a rational grid, and acceptance only when check_primal and the exact minimum squared distance pass.

coordinates: 34 exact rationals (x_0, y_0, ..., x_16, y_16) in the U frame, U = 1169/250; centre k sits in the k-th occupied cell in increasing cell index
